# A1 Car Wash — Hyderabad

> Quality Car Cleaning & Detailing located at Mehfil Restaurant, Raidurg, Darga Chowrasta, Film Nagar Road, Hyderabad, Telangana – 500104.

## Overview
A1 Car Wash is Hyderabad's premier car cleaning and detailing network operating 6 multi-bay studios equipped with heavy-duty hydraulic jack lift ramps, 100% RO soft-water filtration plants, and touchless pH-neutral snow foam.

## Key Services
- **Full Car Wash**: Hydraulic jack lift underbody wash, oil & diesel engine degrease, deep interior cabin vacuum, dashboard polish, active snow foam bath, tyre gloss.
- **Body Wash**: Rapid exterior snow foam bath, RO jet rinse, interior dry vacuuming, dashboard polish.
- **Interior Deep Cleaning Spa**: High-temperature seat and upholstery shampoo extraction, ceiling cleaning, door panels, floor mat extraction, AC vent sanitization.
- **Teflon Coating & 9H Ceramic Shield**: High-gloss fluoropolymer protective coat, swirl mark defense, hydrophobic water beading.
- **Underbody Anti-Rust Coating**: Bitumen chassis rustproofing with zinc silencer spray for monsoon mud and corrosion defense.
- **Bike & Two-Wheeler Detailing**: Dedicated foam wash, diesel engine degrease, and chain lube for commuter bikes, Bullets, and sports bikes.
